page: Vultr voc-c-16c-32gb-500s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. The server is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core, and includes 500 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance characteristics, particularly in single-core processing and memory efficiency. The stress-ng single-core CPU test places this server in the top tier, while multi-core performance falls within the average range. Memory performance is notable, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top tier and large-block read and write memory bandwidth testing in the top 25%. Single-threaded data processing tasks, such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, also demonstrate strong performance. For language model workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds with a small 135M parameter model, though prompt processing and larger 7B model execution remain in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC cores and high-speed NVMe storage provide a balanced resource profile for compute-bound workloads without the overhead of a GPU. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance well-suited for applications requiring dedicated processing power and fast local storage access. Recommended workloads include single-threaded data processing, web serving, database operations, and lightweight machine learning inference tasks that benefit from AVX-512 vector extensions.
description: The Vultr voc-c-16c-32gb-500s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor on the x86_64 architecture. Operating at 2.0 GHz, the CPU includes 8 physical cores with hyper-threading, supported by 32.0 GB of RAM and 500 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark results show top-tier single-core CPU performance and memory scores, alongside strong large-block memory bandwidth and single-threaded compression speeds. Multi-core processing, database operations, and static web serving throughput perform at average levels. Lacking a GPU, this server relies on its dedicated CPU resources and AVX-512 instruction support to deliver efficient processing. It is suited for compute-focused workloads, single-threaded data processing, database operations, and lightweight text generation tasks.
